messages:
maria (release): Heads-up — planning a maintenance window to upgrade the model-serving kernel and kernel-level attention kernel selection. Tentative: Tue 2026-03-24 02:00-04:00 UTC. Affects: rolling restarts of Dedicated pools; Hosted should be seamless but expect transient 503s for <1min during instance replacement.
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: https://internal/deploys/1763601234 - runbook linked. Canary set to 10% of traffic for first 15m.
ajay (support): Need final status page + customer email copy by EOD Fri. Also want a canned reply for support for customers asking about pinning.
kate (comms): Draft status-update for public status page below — please review. I kept it short.
statusbot: [STATUS PAGE DRAFT SAVED]
Kate (comms): ```Incident type: Scheduled maintenance
Start: 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC
Expected end: 2026-03-24 04:00 UTC
Impact: Brief request failures (503) or elevated latency for a subset of requests during rolling restarts. No data loss expected.
What we're doing: Upgrading serving kernel to improve long-sequence latency and reuse for quantized models.
Mitigation: Canary rollout + automatic rollback thresholds. Customers on Dedicated can pin to a stable model minor if desired (instructions below).
Contact: support@redwood.ai or on this thread.```
liam (sre): Can we add automatic rollback triggers? Recommend: rollback if error rate >5% above baseline for >5m OR 95th latency increases >200ms for >5m. Also ensure we don't evict all replicas in a single AZ.
maria (release): Agreed. Canary -> 10% -> 30% -> 100% with 15/15/30 minute holds. Rollback thresholds per Liam. Also add a canary for dedicated customers in region-eu.
ajay (support): Support reply template needed for customers asking how to pin version. Add short steps and a pointer to docs.
kate (comms): Support email template (short): ```Subject: Planned maintenance on 24 Mar — possible brief request failures
Hi <Customer>,
We’re performing a planned upgrade to our model-serving runtime on Tue Mar 24 02:00–04:00 UTC. You may see brief request failures or slightly higher latency for a small percentage of requests while we roll changes across capacity. No data will be lost.
If you rely on fixed model behavior, you can pin to a stable model minor via the Console: Settings → Models → Pin version. See: https://docs.redwood.ai/pinning
If you have concerns or need a maintenance window outside this time, reply and we’ll coordinate.
Thanks,
Redwood Support
```
liam (sre): One more operational note: add pre-check script in runbook to validate quantization kernel compatibility and KV cache warmup. If the pre-check fails, abort and notify on-call.
maria (release): Done — runbook updated. Also setting a config to avoid auto-scaling events during the window to reduce noise.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started at 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z for pool: dedicated-eu-1. Monitoring thresholds applied.
ajay (support): Tagging common customers to pre-notify: @acct-smb1, @acct-enterprise-3. Will send targeted note with the email template.
kate (comms): I'll post the status page entry 30 minutes before start and send the customer email 4 hours prior. Posting both drafts to the shared doc now: https://drive.redwood.ai/maintenance/1763601234
maria (release): Final decision: proceed with canary. If any of the rollback triggers fire, we will immediately rollback to previous kernel and open this thread for updates. Keep support on standby.
ajay (support): Acknowledged. I'll prepare canned responses and a short internal Slack snippet for CS teams.
liam (sre): On-call: @liam (sre) & @sre-oncall-2. If rollback happens, capture traces and tag with `maintenance-1763601234`.
kate (comms): :thumbsup: I'll coordinate external communication.
statusbot: Maintenance window posted to status page as scheduled (will go live 2026-03-24T01:30:00Z).
maria (release): Thanks team — will update here during the rollout and after with postmortem notes and any follow-ups (note: we'll include metrics on error rates and latency in the postmortem).
